name: Iori Ishizuka
source: lori is the other snarky one of the group, known for his wit that he uses on his fellow friends. He is a bookworm, often reading and discussing books with Nerisu and Takataka, sometimes even Yukino when she stops talking about weird conspiracy theories. He enjoys ant as well, but specializes in landscapes. He is also asexual, but isn't sex-repulsed like Tokino.
